bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
compose="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
secret="$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt"
backup="$root/deploy/.gserver-compose.pre-report-mount-20261119.bak"
test -s "$secret" && test -f "$compose" || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 62
cid="${ids[0]}"
project="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}')"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 63
test ! -e "$backup" || exit 64
cp -p "$compose" "$backup"
chmod 600 "$backup"
changed=0
rollback(){
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 if [ "$changed" = 1 ]; then
  cp -p "$backup" "$compose"
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 echo GAYBBS_SECRET_MOUNT_REPAIR=ROLLED_BACK
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
python3 - "$compose" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
path=Path(sys.argv[1])
text=path.read_text()
a="      BOT_TOKEN_FILE: /run/secrets/bot_token\n"
b="      - bot_token\n"
root="\nsecrets:\n"
if text.count(a)!=1 or text.count(b)!=1 or text.count(root)!=1 or "bug_report_recipient" in text:
    raise SystemExit(65)
if "\nservices:\n" not in "\n"+text or text.rfind(root)<text.index("  gaybbs:"):
    raise SystemExit(66)
text=text.replace(a,a+"      GAYBBS_USERBOT_REPORT_CHAT_ID_FILE: /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient\n",1)
text=text.replace(b,b+"      - bug_report_recipient\n",1)
text=text.rstrip()+"\n  bug_report_recipient:\n    file: ./secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt\n"
path.write_text(text)
PY
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 67
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || exit 68
newcid="$(docker compose -p "$project" -f "$compose" ps -q gaybbs)"
test -n "$newcid" || exit 69
docker exec "$newcid" test -r /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient || exit 70
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if [ "$(docker inspect "$newcid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true ] && docker logs "$newcid" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" -eq 1 || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
changed=0
trap - ERR
echo GAYBBS_SECRET_MOUNT_REPAIR=PASS
echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY=PASS
echo REPORT_RECIPIENT_SECRET_READABLE=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_PRESERVED=PASS
